info.name: ShortReel Sprint 1-2
info.description: Positive and negative requests for every Sprint 1-2 feature. Run the folders in order against a throw-away database (see docs/postman/README.md). Uses the seed admin account, so never point it at real data.

item.name: 1 Guest and public
item.description: No token: what a guest can and cannot see.

item.name: Health check

exec: pm.test("Health check: status is 200", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test("API and database are up", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("ok"); pm.expect(body.db).to.eql("up"); });
pm.environment.set("run_id", Date.now().toString(36));

item.name: Guest: feed lists approved films only

exec: pm.test("Guest: feed lists approved films only: status is 200", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var films = pm.response.json().films;
pm.test("feed has films", function () { pm.expect(films.length).to.above(0); });
pm.test("every film is approved", function () { pm.expect(films.filter(function (f) { return f.status !== "approved"; }).length).to.eql(0); });
pm.environment.set("seed_film_id", String(films[0].id));

item.name: Guest: film detail shows episodes with access labels

exec: pm.test("Guest: film detail shows episodes with access labels: status is 200", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var eps = pm.response.json().episodes;
var free = eps.filter(function (e) { return e.is_free; })[0];
var paid = eps.filter(function (e) { return !e.is_free; })[0];
pm.test("a free and a paid episode exist", function () { pm.expect(!!free && !!paid).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("free episode is labelled free, paid one login_required", function () { pm.expect(free.access).to.eql("free"); pm.expect(paid.access).to.eql("login_required"); });
pm.environment.set("free_episode_id", String(free.id));
pm.environment.set("paid_episode_id", String(paid.id));

item.name: Guest: free episode gives a playback link

exec: pm.test("Guest: free episode gives a playback link: status is 200", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test("stream_url is a short-lived link", function () { pm.expect(typeof body.stream_url).to.eql("string"); pm.expect(body.stream_url).to.include("/stream?t="); });
pm.environment.set("free_stream_url", body.stream_url);

item.name: Guest: paid episode has no playback link

exec: pm.test("Guest: paid episode has no playback link: status is 200", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });
var body = pm.response.json();
pm.test("stream_url is null and access is login_required", function () { pm.expect(body.stream_url).to.eql(null); pm.expect(body.episode.access).to.eql("login_required"); });

item.name: Guest: paid episode stream is denied

exec: pm.test("Guest: paid episode stream is denied: status is 401", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(401); });
pm.test("error code", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("UNAUTHENTICATED"); });
